description: Main application code for a Zephyr-based embedded system, configuring UI, handling events, reading sensors, and controlling regulator and LED states.

methods.name: configure_ui
methods.description: Configures UI components such as button and LEDs, checks device readiness.

methods.name: configure_events
methods.description: Sets up event callbacks for PMIC button press events.

methods.name: read_sensors
methods.description: Fetches and prints sensor data including voltage, current, temperature, and charger status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop initializing system, handling button presses, updating regulator states, LEDs, and reading sensors periodically.
